scope.entry_source_policy: Every entry is a canonical Kurmancî entry from ku.wiktionary.org; FreeDict never creates standalone entries.
scope.translation_source_policy: FreeDict is secondary and fills only missing TR/EN/DE values after exact normalized canonical Kurmancî headword matching; existing Wiktionary values are retained and each entry/target is capped at three values.
scope.freedict_license_policy: Package-level licenses are retained in the build audit; selected packages are distributed only with their package license and attribution requirements.
scope.quality_policy: No orphan translations; no independent FreeDict entries; no more than three values per target language; only exact normalized canonical headword matches are accepted.
